page.notes: The left margin notes are small and partly cut; the note "Archelogia Aristotelis, ex ejus scriptis hinc in de conge-sta" is a reconstruction of a line-broken note and may be imperfect. Greek passages in the top paragraph (ταὐτὸ- / ξωὴ θεῷ / ὡς ἐν ὑπῳ) are doubtful and the scan is faint there. The heading "Cap. 4." is set in italic within a decorative ornament line, which is not transcribed. The marginal note "Principia essendi & cognoscendi" is separate from the "de conge-sta" note but close to it.
